usedFor: CentralStationCRM holds deals and Pyrus holds the work, so “New Deal” can open a task through “Create Simple Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal” in Centralstation CRM, then “Create Simple Task” in Pyrus
bestTemplate.why: Every deal gets a task with contacts, so follow-up work starts in Pyrus when sales logs it.

watchOut: “New Deal” in Centralstation CRM is polling, so the Pyrus task appears after a scheduled check.
